integrity: All 4095 nonempty induced vertex subcomplexes are enumerated exactly.
Boundary ranks are computed by exact binary elimination and cross-checked by Euler characteristic.
No sampling, heuristic stopping rule, or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: Acyclicity is computed over F2 only.
Only induced subcomplexes arising from vertex deletion are included.
The result is for the specific labeled B12,38 triangulation and is not generalized to all collapsible evasive balls.
title: Exact mod-two acyclic deletion landscape of the twelve-vertex collapsible evasive ball
